title: RAW UNREVIEWED: crossing channels keep separate contents or form a confluence
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Seek a dated primary hydraulic or anatomical diagram whose own captions distinguish a physical crossing of two channels from a junction that actually exchanges contents. Freeze an already admitted Voynich panel with an unambiguous crossing or junction, its connected endpoints, labels, and full owned prose before proposing any word value. The decisive contrast is continuity of each incoming stream through the feature versus one combined downstream stream. A drawn intersection alone binds neither reading; source identity, direction, and a target written relation are presently missing.

design.mechanism: physical channel intersection preserves two flows or merges them into one
design.unit: one complete admitted connected-channel panel and its locally owned prose
design.contrast: crossing without exchange versus confluence with a shared downstream stream
design.prediction: A source-bound whole reading must preserve the number and ownership of input and output streams across the intersection; merely naming a channel cannot decide the relation.
design.scope: exploratory; source and target meaning binding required before fixed selection
